mapper.select:
select f.found_id as foundId, f.title as title, f.train_no as trainNo, c.category_name as categoryName, f.found_time as foundTime, f.found_location as foundLocation, f.status as status, f.item_image as itemImage from found_item f left join category c on c.category_id = f.category_id
